manifestations.description: severe pain in the right hip
pain in the left knee (became worse post-accident)
tenderness present at right pelvic stable and at right gluteal region
2 cm superficial abrasion at right elbow
difficulty walking up and down staircases; noticeable limp when ascending steps

losses.description: continuing pain in his hip and both knees

could not go back to become a driller again because he could not walk up and down staircases in a construction site with equipment of up to 40 Kg, not to mention climbing up and down scaffoldings and bamboo foldings and working at height.
difficulty with stairs and walking unaided at times; noticeable limp when ascending steps.
